questions.stem: Pointing to a man in a photograph, Rina says, 'He is the son of my father's only brother.' How is the man related to Rina?
questions.explanation: My father's only brother = my paternal uncle. Uncle's son = my cousin.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A and B are brothers. C is A's mother. D is C's husband. How is D related to B?
questions.explanation: C is A's mother. D is C's husband → D is A's father. Since A and B are brothers, D is also B's father.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a girl, Arjun says, 'Her father is the only son of my father.' How is Arjun related to the girl?
questions.explanation: The only son of Arjun's father = Arjun himself. The girl's father = Arjun. Therefore, Arjun is the girl's father.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P is Q's brother. Q is R's sister. R is S's father. How is P related to S?
questions.explanation: P, Q, and R are siblings (P is Q's brother; Q is R's sister). R is S's father. P is R's brother → P is S's paternal uncle.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Meena says about a boy, 'His mother is the wife of my father's son.' How is the boy related to Meena?
questions.explanation: My father's son = Meena's brother (assuming only one). Brother's wife = Meena's sister-in-law. The boy's mother is Meena's sister-in-law → the boy is the son of Meena's brother = Meena's nephew.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the mother of B. B is the brother of C. C is the father of D. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A is B's mother. B and C are siblings → A is also C's mother. C is D's father → A is D's paternal grandmother.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: X is the husband of Y. Z is the son of X. W is the brother of Z. How is Y related to W?
questions.explanation: X and Y are a couple. Z and W are both sons of X. Y is X's wife → Y is the mother of both Z and W.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Ramesh says, 'The girl in the photograph is the daughter of the only son of my father's wife.' How is the girl related to Ramesh?
questions.explanation: My father's wife = Ramesh's mother. Only son of Ramesh's mother = Ramesh himself. So the girl's father = Ramesh → the girl is Ramesh's daughter.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a man, Sunita says, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is Sunita related to the man?
questions.explanation: Only daughter of Sunita's mother = Sunita herself. So the man's mother = Sunita. Therefore, Sunita is the man's mother.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a family, A is married to B. C is the son of A. D is the sister of B. E is the brother of D. How is E related to A?
questions.explanation: D is B's sister. E is D's brother → E is also B's sibling. B is married to A → E (B's brother) is A's brother-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P is Q's brother. R is Q's mother. S is R's father. T is S's wife. How is P related to T?
questions.explanation: P and Q are siblings, so R is also P's mother. S is R's father = P's maternal grandfather. T is S's wife = P's maternal grandmother. P is T's grandson.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a coded language: 'P + Q' means P is the father of Q, and 'P − Q' means P is the wife of Q. What does the expression A + B − C mean regarding A and C?
options: A is the son of C
A is the father-in-law of C
A is the brother of C
A is the uncle of C
questions.explanation: A + B: A is the father of B. B − C: B is the wife of C → B and C are married (B is wife, C is husband). A is B's father → A is C's father-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Priya introduces a boy as 'the son of the only son of my grandmother.' The grandmother has no other children. How is the boy related to Priya?
questions.explanation: My grandmother's only son = Priya's father. The boy's father = Priya's father. So the boy is Priya's brother.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A woman points to a man in a photograph and says, 'His father is the only son of my grandfather.' How is she related to the man?
questions.explanation: My grandfather's only son = my father. The man's father = my father. So the woman and the man share the same father → the woman is the man's sister.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A man introduces a woman as 'the daughter of the mother of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: My mother's mother = my maternal grandmother. Grandmother's daughter = my mother OR my mother's sister (maternal aunt). Since the woman is introduced as a separate person, she is the man's maternal aunt.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P is Q's father. Q is R's brother. S is P's mother. How is S related to R?
questions.explanation: P is Q's father. Q and R are siblings → P is also R's father. S is P's mother → S is Q's and R's paternal grandmother.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a woman, a man says, 'She is the sister of the father of the son of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: Son of my mother = the man himself. Father of the man = the man's father. Sister of the man's father = the man's paternal aunt.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A's mother's brother's wife's daughter is B. How is A related to B?
questions.explanation: A's mother's brother = maternal uncle. Uncle's wife = maternal aunt. Aunt's daughter = A's cousin. So B is A's cousin, and A is B's cousin.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: X is the husband of Y. Z is the son of X. W is the daughter of Z. V is the mother of W. How is V related to Y?
questions.explanation: X and Y are a couple; Z is their son. W is Z's daughter → Z is W's father. V is W's mother → V is Z's wife. Y is Z's mother (X's wife) → V (Z's wife) is Y's daughter-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a family of six: F is father of G. G is sister of H. H is husband of I. J is mother of I. B has no daughters. How is F related to J?
questions.explanation: F is G and H's father. H married I. J is I's mother. F is H's father; J is I's mother. H and I are a married couple — their respective parents F and J are co-parents-in-law (samdhi/samdhiyani relationship in Indian family tradition).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a family tree: M is the grandfather of N. O is the brother of N. P is the daughter of O. Q is O's son. How is M related to Q?
questions.explanation: M is N's grandfather. O is N's brother → O and N are siblings → M is also O's grandfather. Q is O's son → M is Q's great-grandfather.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Rajan points to a girl and says, 'Her mother's brother is the only son of my mother's father.' How is the girl related to Rajan?
questions.explanation: My mother's father = Rajan's maternal grandfather. His only son = Rajan's maternal uncle (mother's brother). The girl's mother's brother = Rajan's maternal uncle → Rajan's mother and the girl's mother are sisters. The girl is Rajan's maternal cousin.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Coded relations: 'A ↑ B' = A is son of B; 'A ↓ B' = A is father of B; 'A → B' = A is sister of B. In the expression P ↑ Q → R ↓ S, how is P related to S?
questions.explanation:
P ↑ Q: P is son of Q → Q is P's father.
Q → R: Q is sister of R → Q and R are siblings.
R ↓ S: R is father of S → R is S's father.
So: R and Q are siblings; Q is P's father → R is P's uncle. R is S's father → P is R's nephew. P is S's cousin, but more precisely P is nephew of R who is S's father, making P and S cousins.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a family: A is the father-in-law of B. B is the wife of C. D is the mother of C. E is the son of D. F is the sister of E. How is F related to B?
questions.explanation: A is B's father-in-law → A is C's father. B is C's wife. D is C's mother (A's wife). E is D's son → E is A's son = C's brother. F is E's sister → F is C's sister. F is C's sister and B is C's wife → F is B's sister-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a man, a woman says, 'His mother's sister is my mother's only daughter.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: My mother's only daughter = the woman herself. So the man's mother's sister = the woman. The man's mother's sister is the woman → the woman is the man's maternal aunt.
questions.subject: Reasoning
